subject: FAR
title: Not-for-Profit Contributions and Net Asset Classification
scenario:
Harlow University, a private not-for-profit university, is preparing its statement of activities for the year ended December 31, Year 2.

Contributions received or pledged during Year 2 are summarized in **Exhibit 1**. Information about donor-restricted net assets, including amounts spent in accordance with donor stipulations, appears in **Exhibit 2**. Other operating information appears in **Exhibit 3**.

Harlow's accounting policy is to report gifts of long-lived assets that carry no donor stipulations as support without donor restrictions when the assets are placed in service (no time restriction is implied). Use the information in the exhibits to complete the tasks that follow.

exhibits.title: Exhibit 1: Contributions Received or Pledged During Year 2
exhibits.content:
| # | Description | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Cash contributions from annual giving campaign, no donor stipulations | $500,000 |
| 2 | Cash gift from an alumna, restricted by the donor for the purchase of laboratory equipment | $200,000 |
| 3 | Cash gift restricted by the donor for use in Year 3 operations | $150,000 |
| 4 | Cash gift to establish a permanent endowment; the corpus must be maintained in perpetuity, and investment income is restricted by the donor for scholarships | $1,000,000 |
| 5 | Unconditional promise to give (pledge) received in December Year 2, due in January Year 3, deemed fully collectible | $120,000 |
| 6 | Conditional promise to give: a donor promised to contribute $300,000 contingent on the university raising an equal amount in new contributions from other donors during Year 3. The matching campaign will not begin until January Year 3, and no cash has been received from this donor. | $300,000 |
| 7 | Audit services donated by a CPA firm. The university would otherwise have purchased these services. | Fair value $40,000 |
| 8 | Volunteer services for the annual phone-a-thon and campus tours, provided by volunteers with no specialized skills | Estimated value $25,000 |
| 9 | Donated computer equipment with no donor stipulations, placed in service during Year 2 | Fair value $60,000 |

exhibits.title: Exhibit 2: Donor-Restricted Net Assets — Selected Information
exhibits.content:
- Net assets with donor restrictions at January 1, Year 2 were **$800,000**. This balance includes a $90,000 gift received in Year 1 that the donor restricted for use in Year 2 operations.
- During Year 2, the university spent **$160,000** of the $200,000 laboratory equipment gift (Exhibit 1, item 2) on qualifying equipment purchases. The remainder will be spent in Year 3.
- The **$90,000** Year 1 time-restricted gift was used for Year 2 operations as the donor stipulated.
- Investment income earned in Year 2 on the permanent endowment, restricted by the donor for scholarships, was **$50,000**.
- Scholarships of **$30,000** were awarded and paid during Year 2 from restricted endowment income.

exhibits.title: Exhibit 3: Other Operating Information for Year 2
exhibits.content:
| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Tuition and fees revenue (net of financial aid) | $2,400,000 |
| Auxiliary enterprises revenue (dining and housing) | $380,000 |
| Interest income on operating cash, no donor restrictions | $12,000 |

In December Year 2, the board of directors voted to designate $250,000 of net assets without donor restrictions as a quasi-endowment for future campus improvements.

tasks.title: Classification of Contributions
tasks.instruction: Refer to Exhibit 1. Select all items that Harlow should report as contribution revenue (support) with donor restrictions on its Year 2 statement of activities.
options: Cash gift of $200,000 restricted for the purchase of laboratory equipment
Cash gift of $150,000 restricted for use in Year 3 operations
Cash gift of $1,000,000 to establish a permanent endowment
Unconditional promise to give of $120,000 due in January Year 3
Cash contributions of $500,000 with no donor stipulations
Conditional promise to give of $300,000
correctAnswer: Cash gift of $200,000 restricted for the purchase of laboratory equipment
Cash gift of $150,000 restricted for use in Year 3 operations
Cash gift of $1,000,000 to establish a permanent endowment
Unconditional promise to give of $120,000 due in January Year 3
tasks.explanation: Purpose-restricted gifts ($200,000 for equipment), time-restricted gifts ($150,000 for Year 3), and perpetual endowment gifts ($1,000,000) are all reported as support with donor restrictions. An unconditional promise to give that is due in a future period ($120,000 due January Year 3) is recognized in the period pledged and carries an implied time restriction, so it is also classified as with donor restrictions. The $500,000 with no donor stipulations is support without donor restrictions. The $300,000 conditional promise is not recognized at all until the matching condition is substantially met.
tasks.explanationJa:
純資産の2区分（with / without donor restrictions）への分類問題です。

**with donor restrictions（制限あり）に分類されるもの:**

| 項目 | 理由 |
|---|---|
| 実験機器目的の $200,000 | 使途制限（purpose restriction） |
| Year 3 使用目的の $150,000 | 期間制限（time restriction） |
| 永久基金 $1,000,000 | 永久制限（perpetual in nature） |
| 翌期回収予定の誓約 $120,000 | 将来期日到来のpledgeには**期間制限が黙示的に付される** |

**含まれないもの:**
- 無条件・無制限の現金寄付 $500,000 → without donor restrictions
- 条件付き寄付 $300,000 → **条件が実質的に充足されるまで一切認識しない**（分類以前の問題）

tasks.title: Contribution Revenue Without Donor Restrictions
tasks.instruction: Refer to Exhibit 1. Calculate total contribution revenue (support) without donor restrictions that Harlow should recognize for Year 2. Exclude net assets released from restrictions (in whole dollars, no commas).
tasks.explanation: Cash contributions with no donor stipulations of $500,000, donated audit services of $40,000 (recognized because they require specialized skills, are provided by individuals possessing those skills, and would otherwise be purchased), and donated computer equipment of $60,000 (no donor stipulations; the university's policy does not imply a time restriction) are all support without donor restrictions. Total = $500,000 + $40,000 + $60,000 = $600,000. The $25,000 of general volunteer services does not meet the recognition criteria and is not recognized.
tasks.explanationJa:
without donor restrictions の寄付収益を集計します。

| 項目 | 金額 | 判定 |
|---|---|---|
| 無制限の現金寄付 | $500,000 | 認識 |
| 監査サービスの寄付 | $40,000 | 専門技能＋購入必要性を満たすため**認識** |
| コンピュータ機器の現物寄付 | $60,000 | 制限なし・時間制限を黙示しない方針のため認識 |
| 一般ボランティア | ($25,000) | 認識要件を満たさず**認識しない** |

合計 = $500,000 + $40,000 + $60,000 = **$600,000**

※制限解除額（released from restrictions）は寄付収益ではなく振替（reclassification）なので含めません。

tasks.title: Contribution Revenue With Donor Restrictions
tasks.instruction: Refer to Exhibit 1. Calculate total contribution revenue (support) with donor restrictions that Harlow should recognize for Year 2 (in whole dollars, no commas).
tasks.explanation: Laboratory equipment gift $200,000 + gift for Year 3 operations $150,000 + permanent endowment gift $1,000,000 + unconditional pledge due January Year 3 $120,000 = $1,470,000. The $300,000 conditional promise is not recognized because the matching condition has not been met. The $50,000 of endowment investment income increases net assets with donor restrictions but is reported as investment return, not contribution revenue.
tasks.explanationJa:
with donor restrictions の寄付収益を集計します。

| 項目 | 金額 |
|---|---|
| 実験機器目的の寄付 | $200,000 |
| Year 3 使用目的の寄付 | $150,000 |
| 永久基金への寄付 | $1,000,000 |
| 翌期期日の無条件誓約 | $120,000 |
| **合計** | **$1,470,000** |

**含めないもの:**
- 条件付き寄付 $300,000: 条件（マッチング）未充足のため認識しない
- 基金運用収益 $50,000: 制限付き純資産を増加させるが、**投資収益**であり寄付収益ではない

tasks.title: Conditional Promise to Give
tasks.instruction: Refer to Exhibit 1, item 6. How should Harlow account for the $300,000 conditional promise to give in its Year 2 financial statements?
options: Recognize contribution revenue with donor restrictions of $300,000 in Year 2
Recognize a refundable advance (liability) of $300,000 in Year 2
Recognize no contribution revenue in Year 2; recognize revenue when the matching condition is substantially met
Recognize contribution revenue of $150,000, representing one-half of the conditional amount
tasks.correctAnswer: Recognize no contribution revenue in Year 2; recognize revenue when the matching condition is substantially met
tasks.explanation: A conditional promise to give — one that depends on the occurrence of a specified future and uncertain event, such as obtaining matching gifts — is recognized only when the condition is substantially met. Because the matching campaign has not begun and no cash has been received, Harlow recognizes nothing in Year 2 (footnote disclosure is appropriate). A refundable advance is recorded only when cash is received before the condition is met.
tasks.explanationJa:
条件付き寄付（conditional promise to give）の取扱いです。

- 条件付き寄付は、**条件が実質的に充足されるまで収益認識しない**（開示のみ）
- マッチング（同額の追加調達）は典型的な「障壁（barrier）」であり、Year 3 のキャンペーン開始前なので未充足
- **現金を先に受け取っていた場合**のみ、refundable advance（返還義務のある前受金＝負債）を計上する。本問では現金未受領のため負債計上も不要

したがって Year 2 では何も認識せず、条件充足時に収益認識します。

tasks.title: Recognition Criteria for Contributed Services
tasks.instruction: Under ASC 958-605, which criterion explains why Harlow recognizes the donated audit services but not the volunteer services?
options: Contributed services are recognized only if they create or enhance nonfinancial assets, or they require specialized skills, are provided by individuals possessing those skills, and would typically need to be purchased if not donated
Contributed services are recognized whenever their fair value can be reasonably estimated
Contributed services are recognized only if the provider is a licensed professional, regardless of whether the services would otherwise be purchased
Contributed services are never recognized as contribution revenue
tasks.correctAnswer: Contributed services are recognized only if they create or enhance nonfinancial assets, or they require specialized skills, are provided by individuals possessing those skills, and would typically need to be purchased if not donated
tasks.explanation: Contributed services are recognized only if (a) they create or enhance nonfinancial assets, or (b) they require specialized skills, are provided by individuals possessing those skills, and would typically need to be purchased if not provided by donation. The CPA firm's audit services meet criterion (b), so $40,000 is recognized. The phone-a-thon and campus tour volunteers have no specialized skills, so their services are not recognized.
tasks.explanationJa:
サービス寄付（contributed services）の認識要件は次の**いずれか**です。

1. **非金融資産を創出または増価**させるサービス（例: 建物建設のボランティア労働）
2. **専門技能**を要し、その技能を持つ者が提供し、寄付がなければ**購入する必要がある**サービス

- CPA事務所の監査サービス（$40,000）→ 要件2を満たす → **認識**
- 電話勧誘・キャンパスツアーのボランティア（$25,000）→ 専門技能なし → **認識しない**

「公正価値が見積れれば認識できる」わけではない点に注意してください。

tasks.title: Net Assets Released From Restrictions
tasks.instruction: Refer to Exhibit 2. Calculate total net assets released from restrictions that Harlow should report for Year 2 (in whole dollars, no commas).
tasks.explanation: Restrictions are released when the purpose is fulfilled or the time restriction expires: qualifying laboratory equipment purchases of $160,000 (purpose restriction satisfied for the amount spent), the $90,000 Year 1 gift used in Year 2 operations (time restriction expired), and $30,000 of scholarships awarded from restricted endowment income (purpose restriction satisfied). Total released = $160,000 + $90,000 + $30,000 = $280,000. The unspent $40,000 of the equipment gift remains restricted.
tasks.explanationJa:
制限解除（net assets released from restrictions）は、**使途の充足**または**期間の経過**により生じます。

| 項目 | 金額 | 解除理由 |
|---|---|---|
| 実験機器の購入支出 | $160,000 | 使途制限の充足（支出した分のみ） |
| Year 1 の期間制限付き寄付 | $90,000 | Year 2 到来により期間制限が消滅 |
| 制限付き運用収益からの奨学金支給 | $30,000 | 使途制限の充足 |
| **合計** | **$280,000** | |

機器寄付の未使用分 $40,000（= $200,000 − $160,000）は引き続き制限付き純資産に残ります。

tasks.title: Net Assets With Donor Restrictions at Year-End
tasks.instruction: Refer to Exhibits 1 and 2. Calculate net assets with donor restrictions at December 31, Year 2 (in whole dollars, no commas).
tasks.explanation: Beginning balance $800,000 + contribution revenue with donor restrictions $1,470,000 (Work Tab 3) + restricted endowment investment income $50,000 − net assets released from restrictions $280,000 (Work Tab 6) = $2,040,000. The board's $250,000 quasi-endowment designation is a board designation of net assets without donor restrictions and does not affect this balance.
tasks.explanationJa:
with donor restrictions 純資産のロールフォワードです。

| 項目 | 金額 |
|---|---|
| 期首残高 | $800,000 |
| ＋ 制限付き寄付収益（Work Tab 3） | $1,470,000 |
| ＋ 制限付き基金運用収益 | $50,000 |
| − 制限解除額（Work Tab 6） | ($280,000) |
| **期末残高** | **$2,040,000** |

※理事会指定の準基金 $250,000 は**理事会の自主的指定**にすぎず、without donor restrictions の内訳のまま。ドナーによる制限ではないため本残高には影響しません。

subject: FAR
title: Contributions and Net Asset Classification for a Not-for-Profit Entity
scenario:
Harborview Community Center is a not-for-profit entity that reports on a calendar-year basis. The controller is preparing the statement of activities for the year ended December 31, Year 5 and must determine the amount and classification of contribution revenue and the ending balances of each net asset class.

The net asset balances at the beginning of Year 5 are shown in **Exhibit 1**. Contributions and other donor transactions occurring during Year 5 are described in **Exhibit 2**. Other Year 5 activity is summarized in **Exhibit 3**.

Harborview's accounting policy is to report a restriction as satisfied when the restricted resources are expended for the specified purpose, and to report a restriction on a contribution of long-lived assets as satisfied when the asset is placed in service. Round all amounts to the nearest whole dollar. Ignore income taxes.

exhibits.title: Exhibit 1: Net Assets at January 1, Year 5
exhibits.content:
| Net asset class | Balance |
| --- | --- |
| Net assets without donor restrictions | $820,000 |
| Net assets with donor restrictions | 460,000 |
| **Total net assets** | **$1,280,000** |

Of the beginning balance of net assets with donor restrictions, $95,000 related to contributions received in prior years that were restricted to the Center's after-school tutoring program.

exhibits.title: Exhibit 2: Contributions and Donor Transactions During Year 5
exhibits.content:
1. Cash contributions of $315,000 were received from the annual fund drive. Donors placed no restrictions on their use.
2. On December 31, Year 5, a donor signed an unconditional promise to pay the Center $50,000 at the end of each of the next four years, with the first payment due December 31, Year 6. The Center measures the promise using a discount rate of 6%. The donor did not limit the use of the amounts promised to any particular program.
3. A corporation promised $100,000 to the Center on the condition that the Center raise $100,000 in matching gifts from other donors by June 30, Year 6. As of December 31, Year 5, the Center had raised $40,000 of qualifying matching gifts. The corporation may withhold the entire amount if the matching goal is not met.
4. A donor contributed $120,000 in cash that the donor specified must be used to purchase playground equipment. During Year 5 the Center used $85,000 of that cash to purchase qualifying equipment, which was placed in service in Year 5. The remaining cash was unspent at December 31, Year 5.
5. A local attorney provided legal services to the Center at no charge. The services required specialized legal skills, were provided by an individual possessing those skills, and would have been purchased from a law firm if they had not been donated. Comparable services would have cost $18,000.
6. Community members contributed 500 hours answering telephones and serving meals at Center events. The Center estimates the value of these hours at $12,000. The services do not require specialized skills and do not create or enhance a nonfinancial asset.
7. A donor contributed a computer system with a fair value of $26,000. The donor placed no restrictions on the asset or on its use.
8. During Year 5 the Center incurred $95,000 of qualifying expenses for the after-school tutoring program, satisfying the restriction on the prior-year contributions described in Exhibit 1.

exhibits.title: Exhibit 3: Other Year 5 Activity
exhibits.content:
| Item | Amount |
| --- | --- |
| Program service fees earned from participants (no donor restrictions) | $410,000 |
| Investment return on board-designated investments (no donor restrictions) | 34,000 |
| Total expenses for Year 5, including the donated legal services and all depreciation | 690,000 |

All Year 5 expenses were incurred for activities reported in net assets without donor restrictions. During Year 5 the governing board designated $200,000 of net assets without donor restrictions for a future building reserve. No donor restrictions were released other than those described in Exhibit 2.

tasks.title: Measurement of the Multiyear Promise
tasks.instruction: Determine the amount at which the four-year unconditional promise to give is measured on December 31, Year 5. Enter the amount in whole dollars, no commas.
tasks.explanation: An unconditional promise to give cash in future periods is measured at the present value of the future cash flows. The present value factor for an ordinary annuity of four payments at 6% is (1 - 1.06^-4) / 0.06 = 3.465106. Multiplying $50,000 by 3.465106 gives $173,255.
tasks.explanationJa:
将来複数年にわたる無条件の寄付約束は、将来キャッシュ・フローの**現在価値**で測定する。

1. 各年の受取額 $50,000、期間4年、割引率6%
2. 年金現価係数 = (1 - 1.06^-4) ÷ 0.06 = **3.465106**
3. 現在価値 = 50,000 × 3.465106 = **$173,255**

約束は Year 5年12月31日に行われ、初回受取は Year 6年12月31日であるため、Year 5に割引額の戻入れ（利息）は生じない。

tasks.title: Contribution Revenue — With Donor Restrictions
tasks.instruction: Determine the total contribution revenue recognized in Year 5 that increases net assets with donor restrictions. Enter the amount in whole dollars, no commas.
tasks.explanation: The $173,255 present value of the multiyear promise is restricted because the amounts are not available until future periods, and the $120,000 cash contribution is restricted to the purchase of playground equipment. Total = $293,255. The corporate promise is conditional and is not recognized.
tasks.explanationJa:
使途制約・時期制約のある寄付収益を集計する。

1. 複数年約束の現在価値 **$173,255** — 将来期間まで使用できないため時期制約が付されたものとして扱う
2. 遊具購入目的の現金寄付 **$120,000** — 使途制約あり
3. マッチング条件付きの$100,000 — **条件付き約束**であり、条件（$100,000のマッチング達成）が未充足のため収益認識しない
4. 合計 = 173,255 + 120,000 = **$293,255**

tasks.title: Contribution Revenue — Without Donor Restrictions
tasks.instruction: Determine the total contribution revenue recognized in Year 5 that increases net assets without donor restrictions. Exclude amounts reclassified from net assets with donor restrictions, program service fees, and investment return. Enter the amount in whole dollars, no commas.
tasks.explanation: Unrestricted cash contributions of $315,000, contributed legal services of $18,000, and the donated computer system of $26,000 total $359,000. The 500 volunteer hours are not recognized. Program service fees and investment return are exchange and investment amounts rather than contributions.
tasks.explanationJa:
制約のない寄付収益を集計する。

1. 年次募金の現金寄付 **$315,000**
2. 弁護士による役務提供 **$18,000** — 専門技能を要し、寄贈がなければ購入していたため認識要件を満たす
3. 現物寄付のコンピュータ **$26,000** — 公正価値で認識
4. ボランティア500時間 $12,000 — 専門技能を要さず、非金融資産の創出・増価にも該当しないため**認識しない**
5. 合計 = 315,000 + 18,000 + 26,000 = **$359,000**

参加費$410,000は交換取引による収益、投資収益$34,000は投資からのリターンであり、いずれも寄付収益ではない。

tasks.title: Net Assets Released From Restrictions
tasks.instruction: Determine the total amount reclassified from net assets with donor restrictions to net assets without donor restrictions in Year 5. Enter the amount in whole dollars, no commas.
tasks.explanation: The $95,000 of prior-year tutoring contributions was released when qualifying program expenses were incurred, and $85,000 of the playground contribution was released when the equipment was purchased and placed in service. Total reclassification = $180,000.
tasks.explanationJa:
制約の充足による純資産の振替額を集計する。

1. 前年からの学習支援プログラム目的の寄付 **$95,000** — Year 5に対応する費用を計上して制約充足
2. 遊具購入目的の寄付のうち支出済み **$85,000** — 設備を取得し供用開始した時点で制約充足
3. 合計 = **$180,000**

遊具寄付の残り$35,000は未支出のため、引き続き使途制約付純資産に留まる。

tasks.title: Ending Net Assets With Donor Restrictions
tasks.instruction: Determine the balance of net assets with donor restrictions at December 31, Year 5. Enter the amount in whole dollars, no commas.
tasks.explanation: Beginning balance of $460,000 plus restricted contribution revenue of $293,255 less reclassifications of $180,000 equals $573,255.
tasks.explanationJa:
使途制約付純資産をロールフォワードする。

1. 期首残高 $460,000
2. 制約付寄付収益 +$293,255（複数年約束173,255 + 遊具目的120,000）
3. 制約充足による振替 △$180,000（95,000 + 85,000）
4. 期末残高 = 460,000 + 293,255 - 180,000 = **$573,255**

条件付き約束$100,000は認識していないため、残高に影響しない。

tasks.title: Items Not Recognized as Contribution Revenue
tasks.instruction: Select every item below that is NOT recognized as contribution revenue in Year 5.
options: The $100,000 promise conditioned on raising matching gifts
The 500 hours of volunteer time valued at $12,000
The donated computer system with a fair value of $26,000
The legal services provided by the attorney, valued at $18,000
The $120,000 contribution restricted to the purchase of playground equipment
The four-year unconditional promise of $50,000 per year
correctAnswer: The $100,000 promise conditioned on raising matching gifts
The 500 hours of volunteer time valued at $12,000
tasks.explanation: A promise that contains a donor-imposed condition, here a measurable barrier plus a right of return, is not recognized until the barrier is overcome; only $40,000 of the required $100,000 in matching gifts had been raised. Volunteer services that neither require specialized skills nor create or enhance a nonfinancial asset fail the recognition criteria. The other four items meet the criteria for recognition in Year 5.
tasks.explanationJa:
認識要件を満たさない項目を選ぶ。

**認識しない**
- マッチング条件付きの$100,000 — 測定可能な障壁と返還請求権を伴う**条件付き約束**。Year 5末時点で$40,000しか集まっておらず障壁は未達
- ボランティア500時間 $12,000 — 専門技能を要さず、非金融資産を創出・増価もしないため役務寄付の認識要件を満たさない

**認識する**
- 現物寄付のコンピュータ $26,000（公正価値で認識）
- 弁護士の役務提供 $18,000（専門技能・購入代替性の要件を満たす）
- 遊具目的の現金寄付 $120,000（使途制約付として認識）
- 4年間の無条件約束（現在価値$173,255で認識）

tasks.title: Research — Recognition of Contributed Services
tasks.instruction: Which section of the FASB Accounting Standards Codification sets out the criteria for recognizing contributions of services? Cite the ASC reference in XXX-XX-XX-XX format.
tasks.explanation: ASC 958-605-25-16 requires recognition of contributed services only if they create or enhance nonfinancial assets, or if they require specialized skills, are provided by individuals possessing those skills, and would typically need to be purchased if not provided by donation.
tasks.explanationJa: ASC 958-605-25-16は役務の寄付を認識する要件を定めている。すなわち、(a) 非金融資産を創出または増価させる場合、または (b) 専門技能を要し、その技能を有する者が提供し、寄贈がなければ通常購入する必要があった場合に限り認識する。本問の弁護士の役務は(b)を満たし、ボランティアの電話対応・配膳はいずれも満たさない。

subject: FAR
title: Contribution Revenue Recognition and Net Asset Classification
scenario:
Riverside Community Alliance is a not-for-profit entity with a fiscal year ending June 30. The organization is preparing its statement of activities for the year ended June 30, Year 4.

The contributions received or promised during the year are described in **Exhibit 1**. Present value information is provided in **Exhibit 2**, and additional information appears in **Exhibit 3**.

Use the exhibits to complete the tasks below. Round all amounts to the nearest whole dollar. Riverside reports contributions restricted by donors whose restrictions are met in the same reporting period as net assets with donor restrictions, and then reports the release.

exhibits.title: Exhibit 1: Contributions for the Year Ended June 30, Year 4
exhibits.content:
1. **Unrestricted cash contributions.** Riverside received $850,000 of cash contributions that donors did not restrict as to purpose or time.

2. **Multi-year promise to give.** On June 30, Year 4, a donor signed an unconditional promise to give $300,000, payable in three equal annual installments of $100,000 on June 30 of Year 5, Year 6, and Year 7. Collection is considered probable and no allowance for uncollectible promises is required.

3. **Purpose-restricted cash contribution.** A donor contributed $200,000 in cash with the stipulation that it be used only for Riverside's youth literacy program. During the year ended June 30, Year 4, Riverside spent $120,000 of that amount on the youth literacy program.

4. **Matching gift promise.** A corporate donor promised $500,000, payable only if Riverside raises $500,000 of matching gifts from other donors by December 31, Year 4. The agreement includes a right of return if the matching threshold is not achieved. As of June 30, Year 4, Riverside had raised $180,000 of qualifying matching gifts. No cash has been received from the corporate donor.

5. **Contributed equipment.** A donor contributed computer equipment with a fair value of $95,000. The donor placed no restrictions on its use, and Riverside would otherwise have purchased comparable equipment.

6. **Contributed services.** Volunteers contributed 2,000 hours staffing the reception desk and performing general office assistance, with an estimated fair value of $40,000. These services do not require specialized skills, and Riverside would not have purchased them if they had not been donated. Separately, a licensed attorney contributed legal services with a fair value of $30,000; the services require specialized skills, were provided by an individual possessing those skills, and Riverside would have purchased them otherwise.

exhibits.title: Exhibit 3: Additional Information
exhibits.content:
1. Riverside's program services expenses were $1,050,000 and management and general expenses were $260,000 for the year ended June 30, Year 4. Fundraising expenses were $185,000.
2. Net assets without donor restrictions were $2,100,000 and net assets with donor restrictions were $640,000 at July 1, Year 3.
3. Riverside has an accounting policy of implying a time restriction on gifts of long-lived assets only when the donor specifies one. No such specification was made for the contributed equipment.
4. All cash contributions were received before June 30, Year 4.

tasks.title: Contribution revenue without donor restrictions
tasks.instruction: Determine the contribution revenue Riverside recognizes without donor restrictions for the year ended June 30, Year 4, before any reclassification for net assets released from restrictions. Enter the amount in whole dollars, no commas.
tasks.explanation: Unrestricted cash of $850,000 + contributed equipment of $95,000 + contributed legal services of $30,000 = $975,000.
tasks.explanationJa:
制約のない寄付収益を集計する。

| 項目 | 金額 | 理由 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 制約なし現金寄付 | $850,000 | 使途・時期の制約なし |
| 現物寄付（設備） | $95,000 | 制約なし。公正価値で収益認識 |
| 弁護士による役務寄付 | $30,000 | 専門技能を要し、通常購入する役務のため認識 |
| **合計** | **$975,000** | |

ボランティアによる一般事務 $40,000 は、専門技能を要さず通常購入しないため認識しない。設備の寄付は、寄付者が時の制約を付していないため制約なしの純資産に計上する。

tasks.title: Contribution revenue with donor restrictions
tasks.instruction: Determine the contribution revenue Riverside recognizes with donor restrictions for the year ended June 30, Year 4, before any reclassification for net assets released from restrictions. Enter the amount in whole dollars, no commas.
tasks.explanation: Present value of the unconditional multi-year promise of $272,325 plus the $200,000 purpose-restricted cash contribution equals $472,325. The $500,000 matching gift promise is conditional and is not recognized.
tasks.explanationJa:
制約付きの寄付収益を集計する。

| 項目 | 金額 | 制約の種類 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 複数年の無条件約束（現在価値） | $272,325 | 時の制約 |
| 使途制約付き現金寄付 | $200,000 | 使途制約 |
| **合計** | **$472,325** | |

マッチング条件付きの $500,000 は、条件（$500,000 のマッチング達成）が期末時点で未達成（$180,000 のみ）であるため、収益として認識しない。

将来入金の約束は、将来期間に入金されるという事実自体が「時の制約」となるため、制約付き純資産に計上する。

tasks.title: Contributions receivable at present value
tasks.instruction: Determine the carrying amount of the contributions receivable from the multi-year promise reported in Riverside's June 30, Year 4 statement of financial position. Enter the amount in whole dollars, no commas.
tasks.explanation: Unconditional promises to give cash in future periods are measured at the present value of the future cash flows: $100,000 x 2.72325 = $272,325.
tasks.explanationJa:
将来期間に入金される無条件の約束は、将来キャッシュ・フローの現在価値で測定する。

1. 各回の入金額: $100,000（Year 5・Year 6・Year 7 の各6月30日）
2. 割引率 5%、3期の年金現価係数: 2.72325
3. 現在価値: $100,000 × 2.72325 = **$272,325**

額面 $300,000 と現在価値 $272,325 の差額 $27,675 は割引額であり、以後の期間に寄付収益の追加として償却する（利息収益ではない）。

tasks.title: Statement of activities extract
tasks.instruction: Complete the following extract from Riverside's statement of activities for the year ended June 30, Year 4. Enter increases as positive numbers and decreases as negative numbers, in whole dollars, no commas.

rows: Total revenues, gains, and other support

cells.rowLabel: Total revenues, gains, and other support
Total revenues, gains, and other support

tasks.explanation: Contribution revenue is $975,000 without donor restrictions and $472,325 with donor restrictions. The $120,000 spent on the youth literacy program is reclassified out of net assets with donor restrictions and into net assets without donor restrictions. Totals are $975,000 + $120,000 = $1,095,000 and $472,325 - $120,000 = $352,325.
tasks.explanationJa:
使途制約が満たされた分は、制約付き純資産から制約なし純資産へ振り替える（reclassification）。

| 行 | 制約なし | 制約付き |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 寄付収益 | $975,000 | $472,325 |
| 制約解除による振替 | +$120,000 | −$120,000 |
| **合計** | **$1,095,000** | **$352,325** |

振替は両欄で同額かつ反対符号となるため、組織全体の純資産合計には影響しない。振替額は制約付き寄付 $200,000 のうち当期に目的どおり支出された $120,000。

tasks.title: Items not recognized as contribution revenue
tasks.instruction: Select all items from Exhibit 1 that Riverside does not recognize as contribution revenue for the year ended June 30, Year 4.
options: The $500,000 promise contingent on raising matching gifts
The 2,000 volunteer hours of general office assistance valued at $40,000
The contributed equipment with a fair value of $95,000
The contributed legal services with a fair value of $30,000
The $200,000 cash contribution restricted to the youth literacy program
correctAnswer: The $500,000 promise contingent on raising matching gifts
The 2,000 volunteer hours of general office assistance valued at $40,000
tasks.explanation: The matching gift promise contains a measurable barrier and a right of return, so it is a conditional promise that is not recognized until the condition is substantially met. Contributed services are recognized only if they create or enhance a nonfinancial asset or require specialized skills that would otherwise be purchased; general office assistance meets neither test.
tasks.explanationJa:
**認識しない項目**

1. マッチング条件付きの $500,000: 測定可能な障壁（$500,000 の資金調達）と返還請求権が存在するため条件付き約束にあたる。条件が実質的に充足されるまで収益認識しない。期末時点の達成額は $180,000 にとどまる。
2. ボランティアによる一般事務 $40,000: 役務寄付は「非金融資産を創出・改良する」か「専門技能を要し、寄付がなければ購入していた」のいずれかを満たす場合のみ認識する。一般事務はどちらも満たさない。

**認識する項目**

- 現物寄付の設備 $95,000: 公正価値で収益認識
- 弁護士の役務 $30,000: 専門技能要件を満たす
- 使途制約付き現金 $200,000: 制約付き収益として認識

tasks.title: Reporting the matching gift promise
tasks.instruction: Select how the $500,000 matching gift promise is reported in Riverside's June 30, Year 4 financial statements.
options: It is not recognized in the financial statements; the promise is disclosed in the notes
It is recognized as contribution revenue with donor restrictions of $500,000
It is recognized as a refundable advance liability of $500,000
tasks.correctAnswer: It is not recognized in the financial statements; the promise is disclosed in the notes
tasks.explanation: A conditional promise to give is not recognized until the conditions are substantially met. Because no cash was received, there is no refundable advance to record; the conditional promise is disclosed.
tasks.explanationJa:
条件付きの寄付約束は、条件が実質的に充足されるまで財務諸表本体には計上しない。

- 期末時点でマッチング達成額は $180,000 にとどまり、条件（$500,000）は未充足
- 現金を受領していないため、返還義務のある前受金（refundable advance）も計上されない
- したがって注記で開示するのみとなる

仮に現金を先に受領していた場合は、条件充足まで refundable advance（負債）として計上する点を区別すること。

tasks.title: Research
tasks.instruction: Identify the authoritative guidance stating that a conditional promise to give shall be recognized when the conditions on which it depends are substantially met. Cite the ASC reference in XXX-XX-XX-XX format.
tasks.explanation: ASC 958-605-25-11 states that a conditional promise to give shall be recognized when the conditions on which it depends are substantially met, that is, when the conditional promise becomes unconditional.
tasks.explanationJa:
ASC 958-605-25-11 は、条件付きの寄付約束（conditional promise to give）は、その条件が実質的に充足された時点、すなわち約束が無条件となった時点で認識すると定めている。

本問のマッチング条件は、測定可能な障壁と返還請求権を伴うため「条件」に該当し、この規定に従って期末時点では認識しない。
